text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the veterinary team in Raheny, particularly highlighting vets Sorcha and Charlotte alongside veterinary nurse Shauna for their expertise and kindness. Clients note that staff take time to answer detailed clinical questions and explain all medical options thoroughly. Reviewers appreciate the warm welcome and reassuring guidance provided throughout appointments.

Clients highlight the remarkable patience and affection demonstrated towards companion animals, including spirited rescue cats and anxious dogs. Pet parents especially commend the practice for providing respectful and compassionate end-of-life care during difficult goodbyes. Owners report that their pets settle comfortably during clinic examinations thanks to the team's soothing and gentle touch.

Reviewers emphasize prompt and dependable medical diagnostics, including early heart murmur detection, in-house x-rays, and effective treatments for chronic ear conditions. Pet owners feel well supported when dealing with accidental ingestions or complex rescue recoveries. Clients express complete trust in the clinical standards and regular health monitoring provided by the Raheny practice.

q.en: Does Village Vets Raheny offer compassionate pet euthanasia support?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention the deep empathy and professional sensitivity provided by vet Charlotte during end-of-life procedures.

q.en: How does the team communicate follow-up results?

a.en: Pet parents report receiving informative and timely phone calls and email updates regarding x-ray results and ongoing care plans.

q.en: Are treatment prices discussed in advance?

a.en: Reviewers appreciate that vets explain treatment costs upfront, ensuring transparent pricing and no unexpected surprises on clinic bills.

q.en: Does the clinic accept routine pet health plan subscriptions?

a.en: Yes, the practice offers comprehensive preventative pet health plans covering routine checks, vaccinations, and parasite control.
